description.value: Parm'z Pizza Factory is a takeout and delivery restaurant on Oak Street in Vancouver's Marpole neighbourhood, serving freshly prepared pizza and Indian food made with no artificial flavours. The menu spans specialty and veggie pizzas, pastas, Indian main dishes, salads, and desserts, with a second location serving Surrey. Cyclists passing through Marpole on Oak Street would find it a convenient stop for a filling meal.
